name: standing glute squeeze
description: A simple standing contraction that wakes up the glutes and helps you feel them working before heavier lifts.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.
